signatures.description: Build a JavaScript tool that analyzes a WebAssembly optimizing compiler’s emitted function bodies and stack maps to find deoptimization statepoints whose live references become invalid after code motion, inlining, or table growth. It must reconcile source-level inline stacks with relocated instruction offsets, distinguish unreachable metadata from real root omissions, and produce a minimal counterexample trace without executing untrusted modules.
